help.title: Help and FAQs
help.intro: Quick answers about using Sgela. Still stuck? Ask your coach from the Support button.

sms.q: I did not get my SMS code
sms.a: Check the number you typed, wait 30 seconds and tap Send a new code. You can ask for up to 5 codes an hour, and each code works for 5 minutes.

results.q: How do I add my expo results?
results.a: Open Me and enter the 6-character code from your expo card under Add expo results, or scan the QR code on the kiosk screen.

guardian.q: Why can't sponsors see me yet?
guardian.a: If you are under 18, a parent or guardian must agree first. Until then you can learn and explore, but sponsors cannot find or invite you.

photo.q: Who can see my profile photo?
photo.a: Only you. It is never shown to sponsors, coaches or other learners, and we remove location data from the photo when you upload it.

privacy.q: How do I change what I share?
privacy.a: Open Me, then Privacy and your data. Every change is saved with the date, and you can change your mind at any time.

data.q: Does Sgela use a lot of data?
data.a: Turn on your phone's data saver and Sgela skips photos on cards. Pages are built to load quickly on slow networks.
